blueprint.name: Remove orphaned IBM Cloud resources (list, then delete)
blueprint.description: Find and DELETE the IBM Cloud resources a failed teardown stranded, for one resource prefix. Two modules: the scan lists, the reap deletes. The reap lists again before it deletes anything, and its deleting step runs only when 'Actually delete' is set — so deploying this with that field blank behaves exactly like the read-only report.

outcomes: Stranded clusters, VPCs, subnets, gateways, COS instances and trusted profiles removed in dependency order
A listing of everything considered, recorded before anything was deleted

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project. The API key needs delete rights on clusters, VPCs, subnets, gateways, COS instances and IAM trusted profiles.

input_summary.label: It does nothing until you switch it on
input_summary.value: Leave 'Actually delete' blank and only the listing runs. Read the output, then set it and re-run the reap module.

input_summary.label: On/off, not a passphrase
input_summary.value: Forge evaluates a step's condition as truthiness, not equality, so any value other than blank/false/0/no/none enables the delete. The real boundary is the prefix, which roksbnkctl enforces itself by only ever touching <prefix>-* resources.

input_summary.label: Re-run if some deletes fail
input_summary.value: It is best-effort and order-dependent: a VPC can refuse while an async cluster delete is still finishing. Running it again is safe and is the documented recovery.

input_summary.label: Teardown
input_summary.value: Destroy is a no-op on both modules. They own no state, so tearing the PROJECT down must not become a second, unreviewed sweep.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix to sweep
required.description: roksbnkctl's cleanup sweeps for resources named <prefix>-* and deletes them in dependency order. This prefix IS the safety boundary — it is the only thing separating your leftovers from the rest of a shared account that holds ROKS clusters across nine regions belonging to other teams. Use the prefix this catalog's blueprints deploy under.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region to sweep. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

optional.name: confirm_delete
optional.label: Actually delete (blank = list only)
optional.description: Blank runs the listing and stops. Any other value (other than false/0/no/none) lets the reap delete what it found.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Filled from the project's credential template at creation.

modules.name: roksbnkctl Orphan Scan
modules.description: roksbnkctl cleanup --dry-run against the workspace prefix. Read-only.

modules.name: roksbnkctl Orphan Reap
modules.description: roksbnkctl cleanup --auto against the workspace prefix. Lists first; deletes only when switched on.
